cards.tooltip: Diamond tokens. Take one — up to three different colours a turn — or take two of this colour alone, which needs four still here.
Sapphire tokens. Take one — up to three different colours a turn — or take two of this colour alone, which needs four still here.
Emerald tokens. Take one — up to three different colours a turn — or take two of this colour alone, which needs four still here.
Ruby tokens. Take one — up to three different colours a turn — or take two of this colour alone, which needs four still here.
Onyx tokens. Take one — up to three different colours a turn — or take two of this colour alone, which needs four still here.
Gold is wild: it pays for any colour. It is never taken directly — reserving a card is what earns one.
Hold a face-up card for later, and take a gold token if any are left. Three reserved cards at a time; buying one gives the slot back. To reserve the top of a deck unseen, click the deck itself.
Stop after one or two tokens. Taking a third ends your turn on its own.
